subject.title: Show model-scoped weekly rows before Daily Routines

question: Should CodexBar adopt model-scoped weekly limits before Daily Routines as the fixed default for Claude web/session and OAuth cards, rather than keeping the current routine-first order or adding user configuration?
rationale: The change is user-visible preference policy, and the supplied related issue is still open with a product-decision label; no maintainer-approved direction is present in the review context.

options.title: Adopt scoped-first default
options.body: Approve this narrow fixed reorder and require source-specific regression tests before merge.

options.title: Keep routine-first ordering
options.body: Retain current behavior and close this PR if Daily Routines is intended to anchor the optional Claude section.

options.title: Design configurable ordering
options.body: Defer the fixed reorder and resolve the broader visibility/order preference direction with the related issues.

recommendation.title: Adopt scoped-first default
recommendation.body: Approve this narrow fixed reorder and require source-specific regression tests before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: Repository ownership and the user-facing default choice make steipete the best available routing candidate.
